ui_bugs.component: PulsePortal site selector / default landing site
ui_bugs.issue: After 'New Site' onboarding for a Pulse Pro customer, the wizard provisions TWO sites for the new org: a Head Office site (0 equipment) AND the actual child site (3 equipment). When the owner first logs in, the portal defaults to the Head Office site, so Operations → Equipment shows 'No equipment found' until the user manually opens the site selector and switches to the child site. This reproduces the user-visible symptom the original bug report describes even though the underlying site_id linkage is now correct. Site selector shows: 'QA Onboard Site 1783436133… Head Office · 0 eq' (default) and 'QA Onboard Site 1783436133 · 3 eq'.
ui_bugs.selector: header site selector button:has-text('QA Onboard Site')

ui_bugs.issue: Original request/spec mentioned 'Pulse Pro' tier data-testid 'onboard-tier-pulse_pro' but actual DOM emits 'onboard-tier-pro' (also 'lite', 'gymaxis'). Not a functional bug, just an id/naming mismatch that broke my first attempt.

action_items: Fix default landing site for new-site onboarding so the owner lands on the actual site (with equipment) rather than the auto-created Head Office. Either: (a) do not create a Head Office site in single-site 'New Site' mode, or (b) mark the child site as the primary/default site for the owner, or (c) make the per-site GET /api/equipment for a Head Office site fall back to include child-site equipment (or aggregate view).

Verify wizard 'New Site' mode intent: is a Head Office really required for a brand-new single-site customer? If not, drop it — otherwise the user's 'equipment count OK at org, empty in portal' bug regresses in perception.
critical_code_review_comments: PulseOnboardingWizard: onboard-tier ids differ from the spec ('pro' vs 'pulse_pro'); align docs/tests with implementation.

onboard_pulse_site for 'new' mode appears to create a Head Office + child site pair even for a single-site customer, which causes portal to default to the empty HO site. Backend equipment fix (site_id threading) is correct in isolation but this org-shape choice re-exposes the same symptom to the user.

rca of the issue: Original bug (equipment created without site_id -> filtered out by per-site query) IS fixed. New residual UX symptom: 'New Site' wizard now provisions a Head Office (0 eq) alongside the actual child site (3 eq); the owner's portal default site is the empty Head Office, so Equipment tab appears empty on first load. Repro: log in as newly onboarded owner → /pulse → Equipment tab (empty). Mitigation: open header site selector → pick the non-HO site → all 3 equipment appear. Long-term fix: skip HO creation for single-site 'New' mode OR make the owner default site the actual operations site OR merge HO+site view.
